dct_title_s: Bolivia (Plurinational State of) - Flood on Mar 27 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[FL-20250327-BOL-00](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_fl_events/items?eventid=FL-20250327-BOL-00) A flood occurred on Mar 27 2025 in Bolivia. It affected an estimated 188218 people and 125898 ha of cropland. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
